fato_historico: 1630: A parliamentarian army defeats a royalist army under James Stanley, 7th Earl of Derby, in the battle of Wigan Lane during the Third English Civial War.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to navigate your emotions with grace. Just as history once witnessed a shift in tides during a turbulent conflict, today you may find that surrendering your need for control brings peace. It is a good time to release past struggles and move forward with a gentle, intuitive heart toward new beginnings.
frase_do_dia: True strength flows like water, adapting to every challenge with grace and gentle wisdom.
significado_numero: Representing the star, this number brings hope and spiritual guidance to you.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let go of situations that no longer serve your growth.
